item.title: Todd Monken close to finalizing Browns coaching staff
item.description: Browns head coach Todd Monken could have his staff of assistants finalized no later than Feb. 18 after spending the weekend interviewing finalists for defensive coordinator. item.title: All-Star LeBron James says he still doesn’t know whether his 23rd NBA season will be his last
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. — LeBron James still hasn’t decided whether his unprecedented 23rd NBA season will be his last. “When I know, you guys will know,” James told reporters Feb. 15 after arriving at Intuit Dome to play in his 21st All-Star Game. “I don’t know. I have no idea. I just want to live. That’s all.” The 41-year-old James again confirmed he is not on a farewell tour this season with the Los Angeles Lakers, even though he teared up during a tribute to his career in Cleveland last month. item.title: Anthony Kim wins LIV Golf Adelaide in a remarkable career comeback
item.description: ADELAIDE, Australia — Anthony Kim walked out of a PGA Tour scoring trailer at Quail Hollow and straight to the parking lot on May 4, 2012. He put his clubs in the trunk and drove away, vanishing from golf and from the public view for 12 years. Kim was all the way back Feb. 15 in Australia, full of swagger and energy, as he capped off a stunning rally — not just in the final round of LIV Golf Adelaide but in life. item.title: Michael Jordan’s Daytona 500 ring: Tyler Reddick’s one-lap lead delivers NASCAR’s biggest win
item.description: DAYTONA BEACH, Fla. — Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win in NASCAR’s season opener. Reddick, in a Toyota for 23XI Racing, led only one lap Feb. 15: the one to the checkered flag for the team owned by the NBA Hall of Famer and three-time Daytona 500 winner Denny Hamlin. “Just incredible how it all played out.
